the characterization of phase separation behavior in pharmaceutical solid dispensions using thermal analysis by structural characterisation (TASC) in conjunction with X-ray micro-computertomography (Xμ-CT) and other conventional characterization methods.
the characterization of the spatial distribution of phase separated drug and carrier in complex pharmaceutical solid dispersions.
the development of novel characterization techniques to investigate the heterogeneity and microstructures of pharmaceutical solid dispersions.
